title: Fall Asleep to the Gospel of John | KJV Bible Audio for Deep Sleep | 3.5 Hours, Black Screen
description:
The complete the Gospel of John from the King James Version, read slowly and softly for sleep.

All 21 chapters, start to finish. No verse numbers, no music swells, no volume spikes. Soft rain sits low underneath the whole way through. The screen goes dark after the first minute so it won't light up your room, and the reading fades out gently at the end instead of stopping cold.

Made for anyone who wants the Word playing while they rest: night owls, early risers, shift workers sleeping through the day, and anyone whose mind won't settle.

"Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid." John 14:27 (KJV)

Tip: turn off Autoplay (the switch at the bottom of the player) so nothing else starts when the reading ends.

Scripture: King James Version (public domain).
Narration: AI-generated voice, produced and mastered by our team.
